obligation: Real ordinal status-and-body comparator
rationale: Independent executable positive/negative cases forbid status-only, body-only and reject-all comparators.

obligation: Start separate slice/baseline TestServers; seed; ten scenario requests; CancelAsync; response disposal; server shutdown
rationale: Preserve real DI roots and no FunnySharp baseline package. Dispose owned HttpClient as with SliceHost; shared static Baseline reservations make a reused process unsuitable for independent reruns. Retain SeedAsync Created precondition and CancelAsync placement status branch.

obligation: Store status, canonical body and allocation/latency/throughput observations
rationale: Record is machine receipt schema and comparator input; metrics informational here, not release allocation budget replacement.

obligation: MeasureAsync, Canonicalize, Append, Truncate, IdentityKeys and iteration constants
independent_owner: Program.Main; three comparator Facts (only Equivalence.Same, not normalization)
rationale: MeasureAsync currently takes canonical body from first warmup and final status from last measured call, so verdict is not a coherent response pair and intermediate differences can be missed. Normalize escaped strings unambiguously: Append inserts decoded strings without JSON escaping. Retain timing/allocation observations and ten scenarios; make per-response evidence coherent in a separately authorized edit.

obligation: Bind scenario identity, both receipts and equivalence verdict
rationale: Receipt lets mismatch outcome map to exact scenario; deleting would lose comparison attribution rather than just boilerplate.

obligation: Build comparator inputs with controlled status/canonical body and zero unrelated metrics
rationale: Factory is not an alternative comparator: cases call real Equivalence.Same. Zero metrics prevent incidental benchmark axes from entering verdict.

obligation: Select status from generated operation responses
rationale: GetProperty fails on missing required status; no silent fallback weakens schema/status detector.

obligation: Read schema ref or inline schema from response content
rationale: Returns empty on absent schema, which required Contains assertions reject. Enumerates first schema-bearing media; retained explicit NDJSON/problem media checks supply independent content-type axis.

obligation: Build reachable states through production Plan with fixed timestamps
rationale: Five factory methods inspected; TryGetValue assertions preserve state reachability. Do not substitute handcrafted states that bypass preceding transitions.

obligation: Fetch real reconciliation and exactly one line availability
rationale: Before/after observer is actual HTTP Effect + inventory read, independent of overridden persistence. Keep Assert.Single rather than accidentally selecting a different line.

obligation: Yield first row then observe and rethrow cancellation from next-row wait
rationale: Token signal and rethrow distinguish real enumeration cancellation from response completion; retain real socket witness and await-foreach disposal.

obligation: Yield first store row then hold later rows on signal
rationale: Uses real PeekStream, EnumeratorCancellation and event-driven wait. Not redundant with CancellableRows: does not translate/capture OCE.

obligation: Thread-safe snapshot of captured exception identities
rationale: Locks writes/read snapshots; generic logger replacement must still capture the exact exception and single count. No duplicate helper proves this observer redundant.

obligation: ILogger adapter captures non-null exceptions, ignores non-exception log entries
rationale: Nested helper type owns exception observation; empty Dispose and null scopes are ordinary logger contract, not fake product behavior.

obligation: Real stock simulator plus token capture, ReleaseStarted signal and optional release gate
rationale: Delegates reads/reservations to real simulator, replacing only Release; preserves integration and avoids polling.

obligation: Real store with Find/Persist/Stream seams, token capture and ungated PeekStream
independent_owner: CancellationTests; PlacementAtomicityTests; StreamingExportTests; ProblemMappingTests; OpenApiTests; TimelineIntegrityTests; UnexpectedExceptionTests
rationale: Create/Remove and default members stay real; PeekStream bypasses overridden stream so post-fault state is an independent observer. A fully fake store would destroy orphan/revision/stock witnesses.

obligation: Explicit admission/completion gates; active-count peak; typed failure/price injection
rationale: Started is a publicly exposed mutable List: writers lock but test assertions enumerate without that lock; capture snapshots under the same lock for deterministic observation. Existing gates and Task.Yield are not fixed waits. Do not replace admission signals or peak observer with delays.

obligation: Real authorization plus call counter
rationale: Preserves authorization behavior while proving absence of unwanted charges. Calls is sufficient for sequential request cases; no need to invent broad mocking framework.

obligation: Construct valid values with production factories; fixed event timestamp; nonempty line precondition
rationale: Helper assertions fail on invalid fixture rather than silently returning default carriers; fixed timestamp removes clock luck.

obligation: Response readers forward test cancellation token
rationale: Four small BCL wrappers centralize token forwarding. Similar client helpers operate requests rather than body reads; merging does not remove an independent observer.

obligation: Request token forwarding; explicit client-token overloads; HeadersRead stream mode; raw-null JSON request
rationale: HeadersRead is required for gated streams; default buffering would deadlock before first row. Do not replace with generic Post helper that erases explicit-token/raw-body partitions.

obligation: Composition through public Build seam; zero latencies; TestServer and Kestrel; valid placement; async shutdown
independent_owner: All hosted tests; two Kestrel tests
rationale: Currently owns WebApplication but loses ownership of its created HttpClient in SliceClient and does not dispose it. Candidate explicit client ownership/disposal preserves server lifetime and test isolation; run socket/cancellation cases after change. Never collapse Kestrel into TestServer.

obligation: Await line event with cancellation and 10s upper bound
rationale: WaitAsync bounds failure, does not delay success or decide outcome by elapsed time. Removing it changes a broken stream into a hung test.
